item.title: Over 5K cold-stunned green iguanas removed during Florida cold spell: FWC
item.description: The Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission announced that over 5,000 invasive green iguanas were removed during Florida's recent cold spell.

item.title: Teen who planned mass shooting at Wimauma church linked to 'Neo-Nazi, Satanic group,' sheriff says
item.description: A teenager was arrested on terrorism and child pornography charges after planning to conduct a mass shooting at a church in Wimauma, according to the Hillsborough County Sheriff's Office.

item.title: Iguana meat pizza becomes Florida menu item after cold snap
item.description: The recent spout of cold weather in South Florida has had unprecedented side effects, causing cold-stunned iguanas to fall from trees before ending up as an unconventional menu item.
